mainLogicTests.scope: Tool root resolution, authoritative launch targets, category copies, cloud catalog availability/search/tags, cloud validation/manager, hardware display profiles, observed Windows names versus saved targets, hardware information formatting, model presets and distribution/update identity.
mainLogicTests.isolation: Temporary tool/data directories, rejection of live network in catalog fixtures and synthetic hardware backends. No real installation, uninstall or hardware writes.

nativeEditorTests.scope: Compiled shared native page, synthetic devices, independent observed Windows names during target edits/device changes/localization rebuilds, local-only categories, draft/reset/model selection, responsive columns, Light/Dark readability and native hover/disabled states.
nativeEditorTests.boundaries: System actions disabled in fixtures. No real registry/PnP writes, real hardware enumeration, administrator product launch or third-party diagnostic application verification.

offlineRuntime.scope: Runtime reused from the earlier verified 20261006 payload; every runtime source file matched its previous payload manifest. The previous offline smoke was not repeated because the runtime files were unchanged.

boundaries: Focused checks only; not a full repository/product acceptance run.
A cached catalog can contain empty definitions; this maintenance hides them at display time without deleting the cache or installed programs.
An HTTP(S) homepage is an actionable catalog source, not proof its remote website was live during these offline checks.
Observed Windows display names and saved local targets are separate; neither establishes a change to actual hardware identity or third-party scans.
Windows may regenerate friendly names; CPUID, firmware, drivers, EDID and storage descriptors can report original hardware.
Memory display names remain local to the editor.
The cloud update manifest is unchanged; the equal 0.1.1 version does not trigger a new automatic update prompt.
